# scm_dlp_edm_dataset_list (Data Source)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] Lists Enterprise DLP Exact Data Match (EDM) Datasets with optional name filtering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List DLP edm datasets, optionally filtered by name.
data "scm_dlp_edm_dataset_list" "all" {}

data "scm_dlp_edm_dataset_list" "by_name" {
  name = "REPLACE_WITH_NAME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Filter datasets by name.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) List of matching EDM datasets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `total` (Number) Total number of datasets matching query.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `active_fields` (Attributes List) Active schema fields for the EDM dataset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--active_fields))
- `all_fields` (Attributes List) All schema fields for the EDM dataset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--all_fields))
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the EDM dataset.
- `index_error_code` (String) Error code if indexing failed.
- `index_status` (String) The index status of the dataset.
- `name` (String) The name of the EDM dataset.
- `region_name` (String) Region where the dataset is stored.
- `tenant_id` (String) The tenant ID.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.

<a id="nestedatt--data--active_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.active_fields`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Field identifier.
- `name` (String) Field name.
- `type` (String) Field type.


<a id="nestedatt--data--all_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.all_fields`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Field name.
